t: You're standing at Raven Row, a free art exhibition centre in Spitalfields, made from numbers 56 and 58 Artillery Lane. The buildings date from about 1690. They were rebuilt in the 1750s for Huguenot silk weavers and traders. This part of the lane was called Raven Row until 1895, and the area was once used for testing artillery. In 2009, 6a architects converted the buildings into a gallery for Alex Sainsbury, who set up a charity to run it. The first exhibition showed work by the New York artist Ray Johnson.
